title: Layer-wise Curriculum Learning for Efficient LLM Compression
abstract: arXiv:2609.19213v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In this paper, we introduce layer-wise curriculum learning for efficient LLM compression. The proposed method facilitates the knowledge transfer from the teacher model to the student model, utilizing a curriculum learning approach that begins with easier optimization tasks and progressively tackles harder ones. In order to adopt the layer-wise learning in LLM compression, we partition the whole model into multiple segments consisting of layers, thereby enabling more computationally efficient knowledge transfer for LLMs. Based on our theoretical analysis of cumulative error phenomenon, layer-wise curriculum learning accelerates convergence while stabilizing the knowledge transfer process. In addition, we present a feature caching method with a multi-threading strategy to efficiently address feature misalignment across layers, maximizing GPU utilization. translated_title: 面向高效大语言模型压缩的逐层课程学习
translated_abstract: 本文提出了一种用于高效大语言模型（LLM）压缩的逐层课程学习方法。该方法借助课程学习策略促进知识从教师模型向学生模型的迁移，即从较容易的优化任务开始，逐步过渡到更难的任务。为了在LLM压缩中采用逐层学习，我们将整个模型划分为由多层组成的多个片段，从而为大语言模型实现计算上更高效的知识迁移。基于对累积误差现象的理论分析，逐层课程学习在加速收敛的同时稳定了知识迁移过程。此外，我们提出了一种结合多线程策略的特征缓存方法，以高效解决跨层特征不对齐的问题，最大化GPU利用率。因此，我们的方法展现出先进的模型压缩性能。
tldr: 提出逐层课程学习方法用于高效LLM压缩，通过将模型分层分段并从易到难地进行知识蒸馏以加速收敛、稳定迁移过程，同时借助多线程特征缓存策略最大化GPU利用率，实现了先进的模型压缩效果。
en_tdlr: Proposes layer-wise curriculum learning for efficient LLM compression, which partitions the model into layer segments and distills knowledge from easy to hard tasks to accelerate convergence and stabilize transfer, while a multi-threaded feature caching strategy maximizes GPU utilization and achieves advanced compression performance.
